en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a park with a curving waterway, a small boat with people, and walkers along a path in the foreground. Dominating the scene is a round medieval brick tower by the water, with a bridge and trees surrounding it; more buildings and a bridge appear in the background. The border is styled like a turned-up page corner. Printed captions identify the place as Nijmegen and Kronenburgerpark, and the left margin lists the publisher. There is a handwritten note at the bottom.
